attribution: David Sabatini laboratory images; Chris Gang manual nuclear/cell outlines; Jones, Carpenter and Golland, CVBIA 2005; Ljosa et al., Nature Methods 2012
scope: Pictures for the empty workspace's start screen only (what to choose before the file picker opens). Display-scaled and resized; never an analysis input, a ground truth or an accuracy claim.
processing: The same region of the 450 x 450 px field in all three (x 60-360, y 60-360). Images: linear display scaling between the 1st and 99.9th percentile of the whole field, 8-bit grey. Mask: the published boolean outline image with its closed outlines filled (scipy.ndimage.binary_fill_holes on the whole field), drawn light on dark as the intake list draws a mask candidate. Resized to 264 x 264 px (Lanczos) and saved as WebP (quality 84).
